contracts: POST /api/studio/configuration/evaluations/export: owner/CSRF, explicit resource revisions/model alias, inverse CSV/template conversion preflight, four reviewed files or diagnostics without partial files.
POST /api/studio/configuration/evaluations/handoff/convert: strict self-contained versioned JSON/digest, existing native conversion and review/apply, no source lookup or automatic run.

final_package_gate.note: Overlaps the broad run; adds two final size/metadata boundary checks. Counts must not be summed.

validation.examples: Dataset package exports, converts and explicitly saves in a fresh workspace without AI; earlier experiment handoff example also passes.
validation.execution: Two restored cases grade through a synthetic provider after source archive; target never receives grading references.
validation.static: Affected Python lint/format, JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace pass. Library controls use wrapping CSS; visual acceptance remains pending.
validation.browser: Not attempted; the prior localhost permission denial was not retried or bypassed.
validation.live_provider: Not invoked; account-specific provider quality and usage remain pending.

guarantees: Full supported dataset text, judge settings and metadata survive reimport without original resources
Codex and Claude Code provider/model/threshold bindings survive the companion round-trip
Quoted/multiline/Unicode cell text and case order remain exact
Original source sequence IDs are not invented; row numbers are explicitly regenerated as 1..N
Unsupported case fields, different judges, arbitrary rubrics and nonportable metadata reject without lossy files
Current positive integer revision pins and existing owner/CSRF protections apply
Export/conversion create no plans, saved records or runs; no managed credentials or artifact bytes are read
Source identity is descriptive; destination needs no access to source resources
Shared bounded JSON reader rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, unsupported versions and digest mismatch
Explicit preview and individual download clicks; native review/plan/apply remain required for import
Existing experiment handoff format and three-file import remain compatible
Empty descriptions remain empty; absent descriptions keep the existing default
limits: Bounded inverse CSV/template profile and one evaluator per package
Native phrase/structured checks, contexts, file roles, arbitrary rubrics and numeric-only judges use native JSON export
Companion required to preserve native provider/model/threshold settings; external-runtime rendering equivalence is not claimed
Package is self-contained only for dataset/evaluator content, not credentials, agents, workflows or deployment
900 KiB per external input and 2 MiB complete prepared set; oversized data is rejected, never truncated
Visual browser, physical-device and live-provider acceptance remain pending
migration: No persisted-state migration; new handoff format is independently versioned as nexus-studio-evaluation-handoff/v1.
next: Reconcile frozen coverage and recent delivery evidence, then identify remaining acceptance gaps.
